literal_meaning: লেশের মাত্রা (কোনো কিছুর অতি সামান্য পরিমাণ)
figurative_meaning_en: a very small amount/the slightest bit
example_sentences_in_english: He doesn't have the slightest bit of shame.
There's not the slightest trace of salt in this food.
note: Often used to emphasize complete absence or extreme minimalism in Bengali discourse.
